description.p: triM. is a modern, fast, and native non-linear video editor designed for Linux. Built with Python 3.12, PySide6 (Qt6), FFmpeg, and PyAV, it provides a clean, precision-oriented workflow for video cutting, trimming, audio mixing, and exporting.

ul.li: Multi-track timeline with ripple edits, snapping, and frame-accurate navigation
Real-time preview monitor with live stereo audio VU metering
Interactive fade handles, picture-in-picture transformations, and color adjustments
Title and text generation with typography controls

description.p: triM. v0.2.0 introduces multi-clip selection and batch manipulation, track mixer with mute/solo controls, audio detach workflow, and Q/W ripple trim shortcuts.
